entries.title: Soup AI training tool enables LLM fine-tuning on laptops #shorts #soupai #llm
entries.summary: Soup is a new open-source tool that enables training custom large language models (LLMs) directly on a laptop without the need for costly cloud GPUs. Developed by a solo engineer from Kazakhstan, Soup simplifies AI fine-tuning by requiring just a single YAML configuration file and one command to initiate training.
